subject: Operating System
questionTextRaw: Suppose in a multiprogramming environment, the following C program segment is executed. A process goes into I/O queue whenever an I/O related operation is performed. Assume that there will always be a context switch whenever a process requests for an I/O, and also whenever the process returns from an I/O. The number of times the process will enter the ready queue during its lifetime (not counting the time the process enters the ready queue when it is run initially) is ___________ . Answer in integer) int main() { int x=0,i=0; scanf("%d",&x); for(i=0; i<20; i++) { x = x+20; printf("%d\n",x); } return 0; }
